description: This Java class defines a command for modifying a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for constructing the command, serializing/deserializing JSON, and managing policies and headers.

classes.name: ModifyThing
classes.description: A command class to modify an existing Thing entity within the Eclipse Ditto framework, supporting policy management and JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of ModifyThing with provided ThingId, Thing, initial policy, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a ModifyThing command.

methods.name: getThing
methods.description: Returns the Thing object to be modified.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing to be modified.

methods.name: getInitialPolicy
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the initial policy JSON if present.

methods.name: getPolicyIdOrPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the policy ID or placeholder string.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer representing the resource path.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the full JSON representation of the entity, including policies if present.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Builds the JSON payload for serialization.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates if the command modifies authorization info (policy or ACL).
